items.label: 1877年
items.title: 质谱仪发明者阿斯顿出生
items.text: 弗朗西斯·阿斯顿生于英国。他造出质谱仪，用磁场分离并称量不同质量的原子，发现多数元素由多种同位素组成，并提出“整数法则”，凭此获1922年诺贝尔化学奖。

sources.fact_quote: for his discovery, by means of his mass spectrograph, of isotopes, in a large number of non-radioactive elements, and for his enunciation of the whole-number rule

items.label: 1925年
items.title: 量子光学奠基人出生
items.text: 罗伊·格劳伯出生在纽约。他把量子力学引入光学，建立光相干性的量子理论，解释了激光等相干光场为何与普通光源行为迥异，为量子光学打下地基，因此分享2005年诺贝尔物理学奖。

sources.fact_quote: for his contribution to the quantum theory of optical coherence

items.label: 1979年
items.title: 先驱者11号首次飞掠土星
items.text: 美国宇航局“先驱者11号”掠过土星，在距云顶约两万公里处成为首颗探访该行星的探测器。它传回440张图像，发现两颗新卫星与一条新环，确认土星磁场存在，并为后来的旅行者号踏勘航路。

sources.date_quote: On Sep. 1, 1979, Pioneer 11 passed within 13,000 miles of Saturn’s cloud tops at a velocity of 71,000 miles per hour.
sources.fact_quote: During the encounter, it sent back data on the planet, its rings, and its satellites, including 440 images.

sources.date_quote: on September 1, 1979 the spacecraft passed through the ring plane at a distance of 35,400 km of the outer edge of the A Ring
sources.fact_quote: Established the existence of and quantified Saturn’s magnetic field.

items.label: 1982年
items.title: 组合逻辑大师柯里辞世
items.text: 美国数学家哈斯克尔·柯里去世。他毕生钻研数学基础，发展出组合子逻辑，提出“柯里悖论”与“柯里–霍华德对应”，后者揭示逻辑与程序语言间的深层联系，编程语言Haskell即以他命名。

sources.date_quote: Died: 1 September 1982 State College, Pennsylvania, USA
sources.fact_quote: Haskell Curry worked in mathematical logic with particular interest in the theory of formal systems and processes.

items.label: 1985年
items.title: 沉睡73年的泰坦尼克号被找到
items.text: 美法联合考察队在大西洋约3800米深的海底找到泰坦尼克号残骸。伍兹霍尔海洋学研究所团队用遥控潜水器“阿尔戈”拖曳摄像机扫描海床，循碎片带锁定船体，也为深海探测技术树立里程碑。

sources.date_quote: The discovery of the Titanic on September 1, 1985, is a tale of two research centers
sources.fact_quote: Just after 1:00 a.m. on September 1, 1985, under more than 12,400 feet of water, one of the Titanic’s boilers was identified, confirming the wreck had been found.

items.label: 1988年
items.title: 粒子物理学家阿尔瓦雷斯离世
items.text: 美国物理学家路易斯·阿尔瓦雷斯在伯克利去世。他用氢气泡室发现大批共振态粒子，获1968年诺贝尔物理学奖；晚年与儿子提出恐龙因小行星撞击而灭绝的假说，掀起地球科学界持续数十年的争论。

sources.fact_quote: for his decisive contributions to elementary particle physics, in particular the discovery of a large number of resonance states, made possible through his development of the technique of using hydrogen bubble chamber and data analysis
